'''Suria''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=bad-territory-trivia-gallery-star-wars-the-bad-batch|text="Bad Territory" Trivia Gallery | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 1}}</ref> located in the [[Suria system]] in the [[Bajic sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and the [[Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="Trail" /> It was situated in grid square P-17 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> Appearing [[Color|blue]] from [[Realspace|space]], Suria was [[orbit]]ed by the [[Suria space station]],<ref name="BT">{{TBB|Bad Territory}}</ref> a common locale for [[Mercenary|mercenaries]], [[assassin]]s,<ref name="DB">{{Databank|suria-space-station|Suria space station}}</ref> and [[bounty hunter]]s alike.<ref name="BT" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|308}}</ref> the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] met the rogue [[clone commando]]s [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] on the [[space station]] above Suria to negotiate a deal.<ref name="BT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Suria first appeared in "[[Bad Territory]],"<ref name="BT" /> the eighth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' that premiered on [[March 20]], [[2024]].<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/bad-territory-episode-guide|text="Bad Territory" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}}</ref> Although it was not identified in the episode itself,<ref name="BT" /> Suria was named simultaneously in the ensuing episode guide on [[StarWars.com]],<ref name="Trivia Gallery" /> the site's [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]],<ref name="DB" /> and within another StarWars.com article.<ref name="D-Class">{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-bad-territory|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Bad Territory"}}</ref> Concept art of the planet and the orbiting space station was done by artist [[Stephan A. Carey|Stephan "Stev" Carey]].<ref name="Concept Art">{{SW|url=bad-territory-concept-art-gallery-star-wars-the-bad-batch|text="Bad Territory" Concept Art Gallery | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 10}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Suria system/Legends|Suria system]] was established in the StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

The reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'',<ref name="CLNE">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref> which was published on [[March 11]], [[2025]],<ref name="DK">{{DK|url=us/book/9780593967102-star-wars-complete-locations-new-edition|text=Star Wars Complete Locations New Edition}}</ref> placed Suria in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] in grid square P-17 on a map of [[the galaxy]]<ref name="CLNE" /> written by [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="TTS">{{WebCite|url=https://tarkinstopshelf.libsyn.com/381-talking-star-wars-complete-locations-with-emily-shkoukani-and-jason-fry|text=381: Talking Star Wars: Complete Locations with Emily Shkoukani and Jason Fry!|date=2025-05-09|work=[https://tarkinstopshelf.libsyn.com Tarkin's Top Shelf]|archivedate=20250511074859}}</ref> along the [[Hyperspace route|route]]<ref name="CLNE" /> known in Legends as the [[Five Veils Route]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> However, the Suria [[Star system|system]] was later moved to the Expansion Region in grid square N-16 by "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]," an appendix published with the [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] on StarWars.com<ref name="Appendix" /> on [[June 24]], 2025. Both works were authored by Fry.<ref name="Substack">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/about-that-new-star-wars-galaxy-map|text=About That New Star Wars Galaxy Map…|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-06-24}}</ref> The second version of the appendix, released on [[October 13]] of that year, restored Suria's original placement in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Substack-2">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/star-wars-galaxy-map-update|text=Star Wars Galaxy Map Update|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-10-13}}</ref>
